Rina: New user hit a painful typing error in the Python sampleapp. Autogenerated .pyi doesn't mark inner fields Optional for models used in async streams.
Ajay: short repro?
Rina: minimal:
```py
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Optional, Dict

class Note(BaseModel):
    text: str
    meta: Optional[Dict[str,str]] = None

async def run(client):
    async for n in client.notes():
        # mypy: Item "None" of "Optional[Dict[str, str]]" has no attribute "items"
        for k, v in n.meta.items():
            pass
```
Rina: mypy output:
main.py:8: error: Item "None" of "Optional[Dict[str, str]]" has no attribute "items"  [attr-defined]
Found 1 error in 1 file

Ajay: sounds like two problems: 1) generator emitted meta: Dict[...] in the .pyi despite default None, 2) some streams may emit control frames (None) so maybe AsyncIterator[Optional[Note]] is correct.
Rina: onboarding hit: new users run mypy --strict and fail on first run, so churn is high.
Ajay: immediate mitigations: sampleapp include `mypy.ini` with relaxed checks and a short docs snippet showing defensive pattern `if n.meta:`. Long-term: change autogen to always wrap fields with default None as Optional[...] in pyi, and audit streams for Optional item types.
ci-bot: CI:autogen-stubs failed mypy checks (https://ci.example/42) :warning:
docs-bot: opened docs PR to add troubleshooting + recommended mypy.ini: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/500
Rina: filing SDK issue with repro + failing CI link. Will add small mypy/pyright test to autogen CI. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
